name: stark-water-tank
description: STARK Environmental Solutions - Foreign Trade Website

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.install:all: cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.db:init: cd server && npx prisma migrate dev --name init && npx prisma db seed
scripts.db:reset: cd server && npx prisma migrate reset --force
scripts.db:migrate: cd server && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:seed: cd server && npx prisma db seed
